Doreen Green was born to Dorian and Maureen Green. She underwent a modification to her genes for unknown reasons that gave her squirrel-like abilities, which manifested predominantly in the form of a prehensile tail. When her parents consulted with a doctor, it was determined that Doreen was not a mutant, although she believed this for a long time
When she was ten years old, Doreen discovered that she could communicate with squirrels after hearing one of these rodents at her window. She subsequently saved this squirrel from being chased by a dog and they became friends. The squirrel, who identified himself as Monkey Joe, encouraged Doreen to use her abilities to help people. Since then, Doreen began to fantasize about becoming a superheroine and came up with the alias "The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl"

When she was fourteen, Doreen ambushed Iron Man in a California forest near Stark Enterprises headquarters and hoped to impress the veteran hero, wishing for him to take her under his wing as his partner. Unimpressed, Iron Man politely refused, when suddenly the duo was attacked by Doctor Doom in a large plane. Doom captured and subdued Iron Man, and began flying over the Pacific Ocean, where he planned to dispose of Iron Man's body once he killed him. Underestimating her, Doom left Squirrel Girl to her own devices. She devised a plan and used her ability to communicate with squirrels through an open door as the ship passed over the forest. Hundreds of squirrels answered her call and flooded Doom's ship, chewing through the cables and swamping the evil dictator with their furry bodies. Iron Man was freed, they emerged victorious, and the two heroes went their separate ways

Shortly after her fifteenth birthday, Squirrel Girl helped Hulk, who was knocked unconscious one day next to his treehouse in the middle of a fight against the Abomination. A concussion had blinded Hulk, so he had to reluctantly accept Squirrel Girl's help. After swarming the Abomination with squirrels, Doreen instructed Hulk on how to move to land blows and dodge attacks until the villain was knocked out.
Later, Squirrel Girl moved to New York City. While fighting crime in Central Park, she saved the Great Lakes Avengers from muggers, for which the GLA recruited her. Alongside her new teammates, Squirrel Girl witnessed the death of Grasshopper and was greatly frightened, but was determined not to give up. Thanks to her squirrel army, Squirrel Girl was able to help stop Maelstrom from destroying the world.

After Squirrel Girl made a fuss to ensure that Monkey Joe was an official member of the team, he was seemingly killed by Doctor Doom out of revenge. In reality, this was a rejected member of the GLA named Leather Boy in a variation of Dr. Doom's disguise. Squirrel Girl found a new squirrel companion, the only one of her squirrel army to have survived Maelstrom's wrath, whom she named Tippy Toe.

Squirrel Powers: Squirrel Girl is a mutate with several traits that are similar to or generally associated with squirrels. Squirrel Girl possesses superhuman strength, speed, agility, and reflexes. She possesses the proportional abilities of a squirrel enlarged to human size.
Superhuman Strength: Squirrel Girl is superhumanly strong and can lift between 800 pounds and 25 tons.
Superhuman Jaw Strength: Doreen's jaws are capable of biting with one million eighty-five thousand pounds of pressure. This allows her, for example, to punch through a steel door in a matter of second
